content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The playful identity is strong, but the tall decorative canopy and oversized headline push the swimming imagery below the first screen.",
  "desktopNote": "The lifebuoy graphic gives the page character, but the four-line headline dominates the hero and pushes its main contact action below the fold.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 2,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 3,
    "distinctiveness": 5
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Reduce the hero headline size and canopy height; use a wider desktop text column so the headline takes fewer lines and the primary contact button fits within the first screen.",
    "Bring a compact version of the lifebuoy image into the phone’s opening composition rather than placing it after the entire text-and-action stack.",
    "Consolidate repeated schedule, location and age information into the ticket cards; keep the FAQ for additional questions and remove the redundant schedule badge from the contact section."
  ]
}
